hold_note: ROWS 4, 11, 12 AND 13 CARRY "hold": true. Neither normalize-plans.mjs NOR apply-queue.mjs contains the string "hold" — the key is dropped by classify() and never read by the applier — so a held row spelled with its real op WOULD BE EXECUTED. Those four rows therefore also carry op:"advisory", which normalize-plans classifies first-class (normalize-plans.mjs:148-152) and apply-queue reports as non-executable because "advisory" is not in its OPS set (apply-queue.mjs:67,88). The op that WOULD be needed is named in each row's would_op and the full intended row is inlined in detail.
